note: READ THE CAVEATS BEFORE QUOTING ANY OF THIS AS A RESULT. (1) Directional only, not a controlled test: the listing changed for all of India at once, with no holdback. (2) Already confounded before we started - the Production track went live 2026-09-02, three days before the listing change, and ad spend/creative moved throughout the window. A post-change delta cannot be attributed to the listing. (3) Volume is too low for significance: at ~139 acquisitions per 28 days, a few installs of week-to-week noise swamps any plausible listing effect. (4) The two figures use DIFFERENT windows - 57.06% is last-90-days, the funnel counts are last-28-days; do not compute a conversion rate by dividing the 28d numbers against the 90d rate (139/322 = 43.2% is the 28d rate, and is not comparable to 57.06%). (5) The 57.06% is for the DEFAULT (en-US) listing, which is what India was served before Sep 5, so it is the right baseline - but after Sep 5 India moves to en-IN and the default-listing number will describe the other 11 countries only. The correct instrument for a real answer is a Play store listing experiment, which has never been run here; revisit when acquisition volume is an order of magnitude higher.
